notes.title: Attack Heroes update version 1.06
notes.notes:
1. Complete optimization of English translations.
2. Tips of going back added on the guide panel.
3. font size and spacing in the starting dialog bubbles adjusted.
4. small slowing down of combo countdowns (making it easier to combo).
5. Updates in Tips button desgins of Compass, Heroes, battles and saving pannel.
6. lowering boss HPs of some stages.
7. reducing star requirements to activate Chapter 4, 5 ,6 and 7.
8. reducting ATK of some NPCs.
9. Bug fixes on scene changes after defeat in 11-10.
10. Bug fixes on mapping errors of the 7th city's border in Crystal-ball.
11. Bug fixes on button showing up in the background in 11-1 and 11-8.
12. Bug fixes on texts beyond border on End-of-World countdown panel.
13. Bug fixes on non-complete display of vitory requirements in a battle.
14. Bug fixes on occational getting stuck on Boss Chou-Tai's showing up.
15. Bug fixes on tips of lacking gold when refreshing Hero combinations.
16. Bug fixes on non-complete display in teaching stage.
17. Bug fixes on occational non-response of hero's check box into battle in Chapter 11.
18. Bug fixes on non-response of pause panel when pressing Enter.
19. Bug fixes on displays of default stage background selects when entering stage.
20. Bug fixes on heros releasing skills in story line after 10-2.

notes.title: 《暴击英雄》1.06版本更新公告
notes.notes:
1.英文翻译进行了全面的优化
2.攻略界面内新增了一个返回的按键提示
3.调整了开场剧情气泡框内的文字大小与换行间隔
4.接力攻击槽的移动速度小幅降低(降低了接力攻击门槛)
5.罗盘界面、武将界面、战斗界面、存档界面的手柄按键的提示按钮样式更新
6.降低了部分关卡的BOSS血量
7.第4/5/6/7章地图开启所需的星星数量分别由：11/16/24/36降低为10/15/22/34
8.降低了部分怪物的攻击
9.修复了11-10战败后跳转场景错误的BUG
10.修复了第7座城池边界在水晶球内穿帮的BUG
11.修复了11-1与11-8背景图上会出现按钮的BUG
12.修复了世界末日倒计时面板文字显示超框的BUG
13.修复了英文版战斗UI内通关条件显示不全的BUG
14.修复了BOSS周泰出场后有时候会站立不动的BUG
15.修复了刷新武将组合金币不足提示金额错误的BUG
16.修复了教学关卡中有一句说明的英文显示不全的BUG
17.修复了第11章武将上阵UI内的勾勾有时候不消失的BUG
18.修复了有时候在战斗中按Enter无法打开暂停界面的BUG
19.修复了进入关卡界面时默认选中的关卡背景显示错误的BUG
20.修复了10-2关卡战斗结束后，播放剧情时武将还会使用技能的BUG

notes.title: Attack Heroes update version 1.02
notes.notes:
Forenotice: newer version 1.02 is coming soon
New contents、promotion and bug fix.

New contents:
1.New 12 stages with stories and cutscenes on section 9.
2.New scenes:the Tower of Kongming.
3.A new stage before the Tower of Kongming on section 8.
4.New pages of detailed guidances.
5.New achievements of combo on following stages.
6.New enemy:the tiger and eargle.

Modification:
1.The color of NPC's name will be different from other words on starting dialogues.
2.Button Y and It can be used to skip the starting plot.
3.Starting plot will be modified and the camera can move a little by itseelf.
4.Modify the guidance systems:
·The battle command will be actived immediately when you follow the tips of guidance.
·You can clearly know what key to press during the guidance of supporting-skills, because it will be a track to the particular hero.
·Modify the arising timing about some guidances.
·The guidances of English will be more detailed and corrected.
5.There will be a new guidance about combo and gold-dropping rules on stage 3-1.
6.The combo will not stop when you watch the story and cutscenes.
7.Modify the showing of UI (It will be more clear when you press the direction keys)
8.The achievement of 6combo will be changed into 5combo on stage 1-3.
9.You will hear the music-effect more timely when your heroes die.
10.The kiss movie(it will be the ver.3 T.T) about XiaoMu will be modified.(It will play appropriately on the basis of their sexs)
11.The heroes haven't unlocked will become shadows (more expectation)
12.There will be music-effects and flashing effects when you unlock the skilles of heroes.
13.The BGM about XiaoMu awakening his power will be canceled.
14.ZhouTai will call LiuBei majesty all the time.
15.Modify the connection of enemy-waves on stages.
16.The pratice mode will become endless.
17.We add some effects of Mars on stages 7-7 and 8-3.
18.The legendary kisses of Xiaomu can be skipped now :P
19.The 中文/繁体 has modified into 简体中文/繁体中文 on setting page.
20.We add an awesome notice in the starting movie :This story is purely fictional
21.ZhouTai's lower body will not be disappeared secretly when he uses his ult-skill in some screen resolutions.
22.Fix the bugs of scene layers on some stages.
23.We cut GanNing's wings and he cannot flying anymore.
24.ZhouTai cannot cut the enemies into paper pieces anymore.
25.Fix the bug of the fog effects that would make you wait for a while before battle.
26.Fix the display bugs that it would always showing the EXP of the hero you last unlocked when you select the lock heros. 
27.Some heroes will not to moan twice when they died.
28.The position of vertical drawing will be correct when you unlock a new hero.
29.The icon bug of ZhouTai's stage(5-5) will be fixed.
30.Fix the bug that the flash of button "next" would stop on the bottom right.
